title: A stored word is preserved outside a footprint
statement: Let $d$ and $d'$ be configurations with the same number of work tapes, symbol type, and input, possibly with different state types, whose tapes agree outside position sets $F_j$. Choose a tape $j$, an integer offset $o$, and a finite word $w$ over the symbol type. Suppose that for every integer $p$ with $-1\le p\le |w|$, the position $o+p$ is outside $F_j$, and tape $j$ of $d$ at $o+p$ contains the $p$-th symbol of $w$ when $p$ is a valid word index and is blank otherwise. Then tape $j$ of $d'$ has the same contents at every such position $o+p$.
hypotheses_covered: Configurations $d$ and $d'$ have the same number of work tapes, symbol type, and input
